entries.summaryEn: Registers a timer: first fire after initialOffset seconds, then every repeatOffset seconds (repeat <= 0 means fire once). Each fire invokes entity.onTimer(timerID, userArg); userArg must be an int. Returns the timer id for delTimer. Shared impl: entity_macro.h:1387 (CLASS::pyAddTimer → ScriptTimersUtil::addTimer, :1391).
entries.summaryZh: 注册定时器：initialOffset 秒后首次触发，之后每 repeatOffset 秒一次 （repeat <= 0 表示只触发一次）。每次触发调用 entity.onTimer(timerID, userArg)；userArg 必须为整数。返回供 delTimer 使用的定时器 id。共享实现：entity_macro.h:1387 （CLASS::pyAddTimer → ScriptTimersUtil::addTimer，:1391）。

entries.summaryEn: EntityCall to the cell part, None until a cell exists. Getter entity.cpp:750 (pyGetCellEntityCall), table :36.
entries.summaryZh: cell 部分的 EntityCall；尚无 cell 时为 None。getter entity.cpp:750（pyGetCellEntityCall），方法表 :36。

entries.summaryEn: Holds the cell properties while no cell exists (.def defaults plus position, direction, spaceID); the dict is consumed (deleted) when the cell entity is created. Installed as a real instance attribute via PyObject_SetAttrString(this, "cellData", ...) — entity.cpp:238-241 (installCellDataAttr), dict lifecycle :221-236.
entries.summaryZh: cell 未创建期间暂存 cell 属性（.def 默认值加 position、direction、 spaceID）；cell 实体创建后该 dict 被消费（删除）。以真实实例属性形式 安装：PyObject_SetAttrString(this, "cellData", ...)—— entity.cpp:238-241（installCellDataAttr），dict 生命周期 :221-236。

entries.summaryEn: Shared entity id (same across base/cell/client views), class name, and destroyed flag. From the shared macro: entity_macro.h:33-35 (table), getters :689 (pyGetID), :1491 (pyGetIsDestroyed), :1496 (pyGetClassName).
entries.summaryZh: 共享实体 id（base/cell/client 三侧一致）、类名、已销毁标志。来自共享宏： entity_macro.h:33-35（方法表），getter :689（pyGetID）、:1491 （pyGetIsDestroyed）、:1496（pyGetClassName）。

entries.summaryEn: EntityCall to the attached client, None when no client is bound. On the base Entity this getter exists (entity.cpp:800, table :37) but is only populated for Proxy-carried clients (see §7).
entries.summaryZh: 挂接客户端的 EntityCall；无客户端绑定时为 None。base Entity 上该 getter 存在（entity.cpp:800，方法表 :37），但只有 Proxy 携带的客户端 才会填充它（见 §7）。

entries.summaryEn: Asks cellapp to create this entity's cell part in the space of cellEntityCall (must be a **direct** cell EntityCall — you cannot pass someBaseRef.cell across a base ref; route it through a base method that carries the direct call). Creation info comes from cellData (.def defaults + position/direction/spaceID). Impl entity.cpp:1416; type checks :1435-1439 (arg must be a direct ENTITYCALL_TYPE_CELL call) → Baseapp::createCellEntity (:1464). Failure raises onCreateCellFailure.
entries.summaryZh: 请求 cellapp 在 cellEntityCall 所在 space 创建本实体的 cell 部分 （必须传**直接** cell EntityCall——不能跨 base 引用传 someBaseRef.cell；须经携带直接调用的 base 方法中转）。创建信息取自 cellData（.def 默认值 + position/direction/spaceID）。实现 entity.cpp:1416；类型检查 :1435-1439（参数必须是直接 ENTITYCALL_TYPE_CELL 调用）→ Baseapp::createCellEntity （:1464）。失败触发 onCreateCellFailure。

entries.summaryEn: Creates a brand-new space (via cellappmgr) and puts this entity's cell into it. cellappIndex=None/0 → engine load balancer picks the cellapp; >0 targets cellapp index N (overflowing indices wrap: with 3 running cellapps, index 4 → cellapp 1). Works well combined with KBEngine.APP_FLAGS_NOT_PARTCIPATING_LOAD_BALANCING to pin large maps. entity.cpp:28 (table), impl :1487-1508 → Baseapp::createCellEntityInNewSpace (:1507).
entries.summaryZh: （经 cellappmgr）新建 space 并把本实体的 cell 放入其中。 cellappIndex=None/0 → 引擎负载均衡器选 cellapp；>0 指定 cellapp 序号 （索引溢出回绕：3 个存活 cellapp 时，索引 4 → cellapp 1）。与 KBEngine.APP_FLAGS_NOT_PARTCIPATING_LOAD_BALANCING 组合可将大地图固定 在指定 cellapp。方法表 entity.cpp:28，实现 :1487-1508 → Baseapp::createCellEntityInNewSpace（:1507）。

entries.summaryEn: Permanent id; 0 means never archived. Getter entity.cpp:769 (pyGetDBID).
entries.summaryZh: 永久 id；0 表示从未归档。getter entity.cpp:769（pyGetDBID）。

entries.summaryEn: Name of the dbmgr interface this entity persists through; empty string when databaseID == 0. Getter entity.cpp:783, table :38.
entries.summaryZh: 本实体持久化所经的 dbmgr 接口名；databaseID == 0 时为空串。getter entity.cpp:783，方法表 :38。

entries.summaryEn: Removes a timer ("All" string removes all). Single-shot timers self-remove — delTimer on an already-removed id raises. entity_macro.h:18, impl :1407; invalid id path :1478 (ScriptTimersUtil::delTimer returns false → error).
entries.summaryZh: 移除定时器（字符串 "All" 移除全部）。单次定时器自动移除——对已移除的 id 调用会报错。entity_macro.h:18，实现 :1407；无效 id 路径 :1478 （ScriptTimersUtil::delTimer 返回 false → 报错）。

entries.summaryEn: Per-entity event dispatch (engine events like onCreateCellFailure-style notifications and user events). entity_macro.h:21-23 (table), impls :1126 (pyRegisterEvent), :1162 (pyDeregisterEvent), :1198 (pyFireEvent).
entries.summaryZh: 实体级事件分发（引擎事件与用户事件）。entity_macro.h:21-23（方法表）， 实现 :1126（pyRegisterEvent）、:1162（pyDeregisterEvent）、:1198 （pyFireEvent）。

entries.summaryEn: Destroys the base part. If a cell part exists it must be destroyed first (destroyCellEntity); destroying while the cell is still being created is deferred until onGetCell (entity.cpp:641 warning). deleteFromDB=True removes the DB record; writeToDB=True (default) archives before teardown, ignored when deleteFromDB is True. Keyword or positional args accepted (METH_VARARGS | METH_KEYWORDS, entity_macro.h:20; parse entity.cpp:663-676; teardown Entity::onDestroyEntity entity.cpp:698-731). Object-reference semantics after destroy (garbages, strong refs) are covered once in [entity-lifecycle-referen
entries.summaryZh: 销毁 base 部分。若 cell 部分尚存必须先 destroyCellEntity；cell 仍在 创建中时销毁被**推迟**到 onGetCell 之后（entity.cpp:641 告警）。 deleteFromDB=True 删除数据库记录；writeToDB=True（默认）在拆除前 归档，deleteFromDB=True 时被忽略。支持关键字或位置参数 （METH_VARARGS | METH_KEYWORDS，entity_macro.h:20；解析 entity.cpp:663-676；拆除 Entity::onDestroyEntity entity.cpp:698-731）。销毁后的对象引用语义（garbages、强引用）统一 记载于 [entity-lifecycle-reference](entity-lifecycle-reference.md)。

entries.summaryEn: Requests destruction of the cell part; errors when there is no cell. Table entity.cpp:29, entry entity.cpp:593 (pyDestroyCellEntity), cellapp message :586 (CellappInterface::onDestroyCellEntityFromBaseapp).
entries.summaryZh: 请求销毁 cell 部分；无 cell 时报错。方法表 entity.cpp:29，入口 entity.cpp:593（pyDestroyCellEntity），cellapp 消息 :586 （CellappInterface::onDestroyCellEntityFromBaseapp）。

entries.summaryEn: Per-entity event dispatch (engine events like onCreateCellFailure-style notifications and user events). entity_macro.h:21-23 (table), impls :1126 (pyRegisterEvent), :1162 (pyDeregisterEvent), :1198 (pyFireEvent).
entries.summaryZh: 实体级事件分发（引擎事件与用户事件）。entity_macro.h:21-23（方法表）， 实现 :1126（pyRegisterEvent）、:1162（pyDeregisterEvent）、:1198 （pyFireEvent）。

entries.summaryEn: Returns attached component instance(s) of the given type; all=True returns every instance, otherwise the first (or an empty result). entity_macro.h:24,1276-1355 (pyGetComponent; all parsed from a bool kwarg :1354).
entries.summaryZh: 返回挂接在实体上的指定类型组件实例；all=True 返回全部实例，否则返回 第一个（或空）。entity_macro.h:24,1276-1355（pyGetComponent；all 由布尔 kwarg 解析 :1354）。

entries.summaryEn: Shared entity id (same across base/cell/client views), class name, and destroyed flag. From the shared macro: entity_macro.h:33-35 (table), getters :689 (pyGetID), :1491 (pyGetIsDestroyed), :1496 (pyGetClassName).
entries.summaryZh: 共享实体 id（base/cell/client 三侧一致）、类名、已销毁标志。来自共享宏： entity_macro.h:33-35（方法表），getter :689（pyGetID）、:1491 （pyGetIsDestroyed）、:1496（pyGetClassName）。

entries.summaryEn: Shared entity id (same across base/cell/client views), class name, and destroyed flag. From the shared macro: entity_macro.h:33-35 (table), getters :689 (pyGetID), :1491 (pyGetIsDestroyed), :1496 (pyGetClassName).
entries.summaryZh: 共享实体 id（base/cell/client 三侧一致）、类名、已销毁标志。来自共享宏： entity_macro.h:33-35（方法表），getter :689（pyGetID）、:1491 （pyGetIsDestroyed）、:1496（pyGetClassName）。

entries.summaryEn: Cell creation request failed. entity.cpp:877-884.
entries.summaryZh: cell 创建请求失败。entity.cpp:877-884。

entries.summaryEn: Fired after the base part is actually destroyed. entity.cpp:164-169.
entries.summaryZh: base 部分真正销毁之后触发。entity.cpp:164-169。

entries.summaryEn: Cell part attached (onGetCell, entity.cpp:1014-1032; auto-destroy fallback :1037) / cell part detached (onLoseCell, entity.cpp:1052-1065; auto-destroy fallback :1069). The source material's advice stands: a self.destroy() in onLoseCell is the reliable place to tear down the base part.
entries.summaryZh: cell 部分挂接（onGetCell，entity.cpp:1014-1032；自动销毁兜底 :1037）/ cell 部分卸下（onLoseCell，entity.cpp:1052-1065；自动销毁 兜底 :1069）。源料的建议成立：在 onLoseCell 里 self.destroy() 是 拆除 base 部分的可靠时机。

entries.summaryEn: Cell part attached (onGetCell, entity.cpp:1014-1032; auto-destroy fallback :1037) / cell part detached (onLoseCell, entity.cpp:1052-1065; auto-destroy fallback :1069). The source material's advice stands: a self.destroy() in onLoseCell is the reliable place to tear down the base part.
entries.summaryZh: cell 部分挂接（onGetCell，entity.cpp:1014-1032；自动销毁兜底 :1037）/ cell 部分卸下（onLoseCell，entity.cpp:1052-1065；自动销毁 兜底 :1069）。源料的建议成立：在 onLoseCell 里 self.destroy() 是 拆除 base 部分的可靠时机。

entries.summaryEn: Called before an archive write; returning False aborts this write, True (or absence of the callback) proceeds. Invoked inside Entity::onCellWriteToDBCompleted before the write — entity.cpp:1294-1305.
entries.summaryZh: 归档写入前调用；返回 False 中止本次写入，返回 True（或未实现该回调）则 继续。在 Entity::onCellWriteToDBCompleted 内、写入前触发—— entity.cpp:1294-1305。

entries.summaryEn: Called when this entity is recreated on another baseapp after the original baseapp crashed (backup/restore flow; handlers in kbe/src/server/baseapp/restore_entity_handler.cpp). entity.cpp:1077-1083.
entries.summaryZh: 原 baseapp 崩溃后本实体在别的 baseapp 上重建（备份/恢复流程，处理器见 kbe/src/server/baseapp/restore_entity_handler.cpp）时触发。 entity.cpp:1077-1083。

entries.summaryEn: Timer callback; must be defined on the base part. Raised from Entity::onTimer (kbe/src/server/baseapp/entity.cpp:1658-1662).
entries.summaryZh: 定时器回调；必须定义在 base 部分。由 Entity::onTimer 触发 （kbe/src/server/baseapp/entity.cpp:1658-1662）。

entries.summaryEn: Fires when entity data is about to be written to the database; cellData is the dict that will be stored. Calling writeToDB inside it loops forever. entity.cpp:1397-1405.
entries.summaryZh: 实体数据即将写入数据库时触发；cellData 为将入库的 dict。在此回调内再 调 writeToDB 会无限循环。entity.cpp:1397-1405。

entries.summaryEn: Per-entity event dispatch (engine events like onCreateCellFailure-style notifications and user events). entity_macro.h:21-23 (table), impls :1126 (pyRegisterEvent), :1162 (pyDeregisterEvent), :1198 (pyFireEvent).
entries.summaryZh: 实体级事件分发（引擎事件与用户事件）。entity_macro.h:21-23（方法表）， 实现 :1126（pyRegisterEvent）、:1162（pyDeregisterEvent）、:1198 （pyFireEvent）。

entries.summaryEn: Auto-archive / auto-backup strategy: True, False, or KBEngine.NEXT_ONLY (one scheduled pass, then flips to False). The archiver periodically sweeps entities using these flags — kbe/src/server/baseapp/archiver.cpp (sweep timer; flag handling entity.cpp:842-899 getters/setters, table entity.cpp:40-41).
entries.summaryZh: 自动归档 / 自动备份策略：True、False 或 KBEngine.NEXT_ONLY （下一调度周期执行一次后自动翻转为 False）。归档器周期性按这些标志扫描 实体——kbe/src/server/baseapp/archiver.cpp（扫描定时器；标志处理见 getter/setter entity.cpp:842-899，方法表 entity.cpp:40-41）。

entries.summaryEn: Auto-archive / auto-backup strategy: True, False, or KBEngine.NEXT_ONLY (one scheduled pass, then flips to False). The archiver periodically sweeps entities using these flags — kbe/src/server/baseapp/archiver.cpp (sweep timer; flag handling entity.cpp:842-899 getters/setters, table entity.cpp:40-41).
entries.summaryZh: 自动归档 / 自动备份策略：True、False 或 KBEngine.NEXT_ONLY （下一调度周期执行一次后自动翻转为 False）。归档器周期性按这些标志扫描 实体——kbe/src/server/baseapp/archiver.cpp（扫描定时器；标志处理见 getter/setter entity.cpp:842-899，方法表 entity.cpp:40-41）。

entries.summaryEn: Archives the entity to the database. callback(success, baseEntity) fires when the dbmgr write completes (onWriteToDBCallback, entity.cpp:1239-1290). shouldAutoLoad=True marks the record for auto-load at server start (then onAutoLoadEntityCreate / createEntityAnywhereFromDBID runs — see [api-baseapp](api-baseapp.md) §8). Core write path Entity::writeToDB entity.cpp:1141-1185; script entry entity_macro.h:19,832.
entries.summaryZh: 把实体归档进数据库。dbmgr 写入完成后触发 callback(success, baseEntity)（onWriteToDBCallback， entity.cpp:1239-1290）。shouldAutoLoad=True 把记录标记为开服自动加载 （届时走 onAutoLoadEntityCreate / createEntityAnywhereFromDBID——见 [api-baseapp](api-baseapp.md) §8）。核心写路径 Entity::writeToDB entity.cpp:1141-1185；脚本入口 entity_macro.h:19,832。

entries.summaryEn: Address of the **internal** network interface as a (uint32 ip, uint32 port) tuple (numeric, network byte order). Impl baseapp.cpp:5179.
entries.summaryZh: **内部**网络接口地址，(uint32 ip, uint32 port) 元组（数值、网络字节 序）。实现 baseapp.cpp:5179。

entries.summaryEn: Register/remove a watched variable under scripts/... for the monitoring system (GUIConsole/telnet). dataType is a basetype string (e.g. UINT32). getFunction is called with no args each time the watcher samples the value. kbe/src/lib/pyscript/pywatcher.cpp:184-185.
entries.summaryZh: 向监控系统（GUIConsole/telnet）注册/删除 scripts/... 下的监视变量。 dataType 为基础类型字符串（如 UINT32）。每次采样时无参调用 getFunction 取值。kbe/src/lib/pyscript/pywatcher.cpp:184-185。

entries.summaryEn: Dict-like object **replicated across all baseapps**. Top-level assignments broadcast to every baseapp; mutations of a value's internals do **not** broadcast (the classic [1,2,3] vs [1,7,3] pitfall from the source material stands). Keys/values must be serializable by the engine. Writes trigger onBaseAppData / onBaseAppDataDel everywhere. Installed baseapp.cpp:461 (GlobalDataClient(DBMGR_TYPE, GlobalDataServer::BASEAPP_DATA), :457); change ingestion baseapp.cpp:3654+.
entries.summaryZh: **跨所有 baseapp 复制**的 dict 型对象。顶层赋值向全部 baseapp 广播；修改 值内部**不会**广播（源料的 [1,2,3] vs [1,7,3] 陷阱成立）。键值须经 引擎序列化。写入在所有进程触发 onBaseAppData / onBaseAppDataDel。 安装 baseapp.cpp:461 （GlobalDataClient(DBMGR_TYPE, GlobalDataServer::BASEAPP_DATA)，:457）； 变更接收 baseapp.cpp:3654+。

entries.summaryEn: Billing request forwarded to the interfaces process. pycallback prototype: (orderID, dbID, success, datas), invoked when interfaces calls chargeResponse. Entry baseapp.cpp:3435; the loss/unknown-order path raises the entry-script callback onLoseChargeCB (baseapp.cpp:3603).
entries.summaryZh: 计费请求转发到 interfaces 进程。pycallback 原型： (orderID, dbID, success, datas)，interfaces 调用 chargeResponse 时触发。 入口 baseapp.cpp:3435；订单丢失/未知路径触发入口脚本回调 onLoseChargeCB（baseapp.cpp:3603）。

entries.summaryEn: Read-only string naming the running component type — 'baseapp' on this process. kbe/src/lib/pyscript/script.cpp:248.
entries.summaryZh: 只读字符串，标明当前运行的组件类型——本进程为 'baseapp'。 kbe/src/lib/pyscript/script.cpp:248。

entries.summaryEn: Alias of createEntityLocally — same handler (baseapp.cpp:431).
entries.summaryZh: createEntityLocally 的别名——同一处理函数（baseapp.cpp:431）。

entries.summaryEn: Asks baseappmgr to pick a suitable baseapp and create the entity there; preferred over createEntityLocally for load balancing. callback(entityCall | None) fires on completion. Entry baseapp.cpp:986 (sends onCreateEntityAnywhere to baseappmgr); the chosen baseapp executes it via the interface handler (baseapp_interface.h:116), callback delivered through onCreateEntityAnywhereCallback (baseapp_interface.h:119).
entries.summaryZh: 请求 baseappmgr 挑选合适的 baseapp 创建实体；出于负载均衡优先于 createEntityLocally。完成后 callback(entityCall | None) 触发。入口 baseapp.cpp:986（向 baseappmgr 发 onCreateEntityAnywhere）；被选中的 baseapp 经接口处理函数执行（baseapp_interface.h:116），回调经 onCreateEntityAnywhereCallback 送回（baseapp_interface.h:119）。

entries.summaryEn: Same as above but baseappmgr chooses the target baseapp. Entry baseapp.cpp:1440.
entries.summaryZh: 同上，但由 baseappmgr 选择目标 baseapp。入口 baseapp.cpp:1440。

entries.summaryEn: Loads the archived entity from the database **onto this baseapp**. If the entity is already checked out, the callback receives a reference to the existing entity. Callback: (baseRef, databaseID, wasActive); on failure (None, 0, False). Entry baseapp.cpp:1088.
entries.summaryZh: 从数据库加载已归档实体，落在本 baseapp 上。若实体已被检出（checked out），回调返回既有实体的引用。回调：(baseRef, databaseID, wasActive)； 失败时 (None, 0, False)。入口 baseapp.cpp:1088。

entries.summaryEn: Creates a new base entity **on this baseapp** and returns the direct entity object immediately — no callback, no round trip. Use when you must manage the life cycle (control when destroy happens) or touch attributes not exposed through EntityCall; some APIs require a direct reference (e.g. Proxy.giveClientTo). Registration maps both createEntity and createEntityLocally to the same handler (baseapp.cpp:431-432; entry baseapp.cpp:959).
entries.summaryZh: 在**本 baseapp** 上新建 base 实体，立即返回直接实体对象——无回调、无网络 往返。需要掌管生命周期（控制 destroy 时机）或访问 EntityCall 未暴露的 属性时使用；部分 API 只接受直接引用（如 Proxy.giveClientTo）。 注册处将 createEntity 与 createEntityLocally 映射到同一处理函数 （baseapp.cpp:431-432；入口 baseapp.cpp:959）。

entries.summaryEn: Like createEntityAnywhere but pinned to the baseapp owning baseMB (a base EntityCall). Entry baseapp.cpp:1028; remote path baseapp_interface.h:122-125.
entries.summaryZh: 同 createEntityAnywhere，但固定在 baseMB（base EntityCall）所属的 baseapp 上创建。入口 baseapp.cpp:1028；远端路径 baseapp_interface.h:122-125。

entries.summaryEn: Loads from the database onto the baseapp owning baseMB. Entry baseapp.cpp:1966.
entries.summaryZh: 从数据库加载，落到 baseMB 所属 baseapp。入口 baseapp.cpp:1966。

entries.summaryEn: Prints the engine-tracked extended-object counters (FixedArray, FixedDict, Entity, EntityCall, ...). Non-zero counters at clean shutdown mean leaked engine-wrapped Python objects. entity_app.h:453 → kbe/src/lib/pyscript/py_gc.cpp:224 (PyGC::__py_debugTracing). For leaked entity instances see KBEngine.entities.garbages — [entity-lifecycle-reference](entity-lifecycle-reference.md).
entries.summaryZh: 输出引擎跟踪的扩展对象计数器（FixedArray、FixedDict、Entity、 EntityCall 等）。正常关服时计数非零即存在引擎封装对象的泄漏。 entity_app.h:453 → kbe/src/lib/pyscript/py_gc.cpp:224 （PyGC::__py_debugTracing）。泄漏实体实例另见 KBEngine.entities.garbages——[entity-lifecycle-reference](entity-lifecycle-reference.md)。

entries.summaryEn: Deletes the archived entity (and child-table rows) from the database. If the entity is currently checked out, deletion fails and the callback receives its entityCall; otherwise True. Entry baseapp.cpp:5189.
entries.summaryZh: 从数据库删除已归档实体（含属性生成的子表数据）。若实体正被检出，删除 失败且回调收到其 entityCall；成功则回调 True。入口 baseapp.cpp:5189。

entries.summaryEn: Register/remove a watched variable under scripts/... for the monitoring system (GUIConsole/telnet). dataType is a basetype string (e.g. UINT32). getFunction is called with no args each time the watcher samples the value. kbe/src/lib/pyscript/pywatcher.cpp:184-185.
entries.summaryZh: 向监控系统（GUIConsole/telnet）注册/删除 scripts/... 下的监视变量。 dataType 为基础类型字符串（如 UINT32）。每次采样时无参调用 getFunction 取值。kbe/src/lib/pyscript/pywatcher.cpp:184-185。

entries.summaryEn: Hooks a raw fd/socket into the engine's network dispatcher: callback(fd) fires on readability / writability. Baseapp registration baseapp.cpp:441-444 → kbe/src/lib/server/py_file_descriptor.cpp:35 and :22-31 (register/deregister against Components' dispatcher).
entries.summaryZh: 把裸 fd/socket 挂进引擎网络分发器：可读/可写时 callback(fd) 触发。 baseapp 注册 baseapp.cpp:441-444 → kbe/src/lib/server/py_file_descriptor.cpp:35 及 :22-31 （对 Components 的分发器 register/deregister）。

entries.summaryEn: Live-entity registry for this process (ENTITY_ID → strong-ref PyObjectPtr). Lifetime/garbage semantics are documented once in [entity-lifecycle-reference](entity-lifecycle-reference.md); installed at kbe/src/lib/server/entity_app.h:411.
entries.summaryZh: 本进程存活实体注册表（ENTITY_ID → 强引用 PyObjectPtr）。生命周期/垃圾 语义统一记载于 [entity-lifecycle-reference](entity-lifecycle-reference.md)；安装位置 kbe/src/lib/server/entity_app.h:411。

entries.summaryEn: Sends a raw DB command (SQL for MySQL) through dbmgr. Callback: (result, rows, insertid, error) — result is None when the command has no result set or errors; rows counts affected rows; insertid is mysql_insert_id()-like, MySQL-only; error is None unless failed. The source material's warning stands and is structural: if the entity is checked out, later archiving **overwrites** direct SQL edits — do not read/modify entity data this way. Entry baseapp.cpp:3214.

Returns the space-data string for key. Space data arrives from the server (setSpaceData on the server side); the client keeps it in the spacedatas_ map. __py_GetSpaceData raises TypeError when the argument count is wrong and when the key is not present — **missing keys are an exception, not None** (kbe/src/lib/client_lib/clientobjectbase.cpp:2420-2450).
entries.summaryZh: 返回 key 对应的 space 数据字符串。space 数据由服务端下发（服务端 setSpaceData），客户端存于 spacedatas_ 映射。__py_GetSpaceData 在参数 个数不对、以及 key 不存在时抛 TypeError——**key 缺失是异常，不是 None**（kbe/src/lib/client_lib/clientobjectbase.cpp:2420-2450）。

Returns the entity the client controls, or None when there is none (e.g. before login). The C++ path is ClientObjectBase::pPlayer() — a direct lookup of the client's entityID_ in the live registry (kbe/src/lib/client_lib/clientobjectbase.cpp:1153-1156) — wrapped by __py_getPlayer which INCREFs and returns the entity or S_Return (→ None) (clientobjectbase.cpp:1159-1171). The registry behind it is the same Entities<T> map documented in [Entity lifecycle](entity-lifecycle-reference.md).
entries.summaryZh: 返回当前客户端控制的实体；不存在时（如未登录）返回 None。C++ 路径是 ClientObjectBase::pPlayer()——用客户端的 entityID_ 在活跃注册表里直接 查找（kbe/src/lib/client_lib/clientobjectbase.cpp:1153-1156）——再由 __py_getPlayer 包装，INCREF 后返回实体或 S_Return（→ None） （clientobjectbase.cpp:1159-1171）。背后的注册表正是 [Entity 生命周期](entity-lifecycle-reference.md)所述的同一个 Entities<T> 映射。

Submits the script's verdict for an onRequestAccountLogin callback. **Trigger timing**: call it after your third-party platform check finishes; the engine is parked on the pending-request map until then.
entries.summaryZh: 提交脚本对 onRequestAccountLogin 回调的处理结论。**触发时机**：第三方 平台核验完成后调用；在此之前引擎把请求挂起在 pending-request 表上。

entries.summaryEn: Registers a timer on the interfaces main loop. **Trigger timing**: the callback first fires after initialOffset seconds of game time, then every repeatOffset seconds while it is set.
entries.summaryZh: 在 interfaces 主循环上注册定时器。**触发时机**：回调先在 initialOffset 秒游戏时间后执行一次，之后每 repeatOffset 秒执行一次（只要未移除）。

entries.summaryEn: Executes a raw DB command through dbmgr. The material's caveat stands and is structural: entity data written this way can be overwritten by a later entity archive — prefer the entity DB API for entity data.
entries.summaryZh: 经 dbmgr 执行原始数据库命令。源料的告诫是结构性的：用本函数改实体数据， 可能被实体后续归档覆盖——实体数据请走实体 DB API。
